decisions.reason: The existing message-21 MODIFY already records the Small Block ticket eligibility window and post-draw reset entailed by the source decision.
The existing message-21 MODIFY already records the Big Block ticket eligibility window and post-draw reset entailed by the source decision.
The existing message-21 MODIFY already captures issuance of distinct Small and Big Block tickets and their corresponding eligibility cycles.
The source explicitly leaves no-referral random ticket allocation unchanged; changing draw eligibility does not alter its allocation trigger or recipient selection.
The existing message-21 INTRODUCE already records the independent Small and Big Block counters and their respective post-draw resets.
The client explicitly states that manual claim remains unchanged, so the winner-eligibility modification does not alter prize collection.
The client explicitly states that the automatic $5 commission remains unchanged.
The source preserves secondary royalties; the revised ticket eligibility does not change whether royalties are enforced.
The existing message-21 INTRODUCE already captures display of the two ticket counters and permanent badges, so no additional metadata update is required.
The winner-selection eligibility change has no semantic effect on product naming or site branding.
